messages.content:
다음 운영·모니터링 계획을 만들어줘: 주간 팀 가용량 대시보드
맥락: 대시보드는 역할별 예정 작업, 진행 작업, 차단 작업, 가용량을 보여줘야 한다.
산출물: 지표 정의, 데이터 원본, 검토 주기
각 지표를 정의하고 할당된 일을 완료된 일과 같게 보지 않는다.
팀 가용량 대시보드 — 역할별 예정·진행·차단 작업, 가용량 — 지표 정의 + 데이터 원본 + 검토 주기.

Create an operating and monitoring plan for a weekly team-capacity dashboard. Context: The dashboard should show planned work, active work, blocked work, and available capacity by role. Deliver: a metric definition, data-source list, and review cadence. Define each metric and do not equate assigned work with completed work.
Team capacity dashboard — planned/active/blocked work + role capacity — metric definitions + data sources + review cadence.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for a weekly team-capacity dashboard.
Define each metric and do not equate assigned work with completed work.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about a weekly team-capacity dashboard.
Define each metric and do not equate assigned work with completed work.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
